russia_1914.desc: Russian Empire 1914: three equal horizontal stripes, white on top, blue in the middle, red at the bottom (civil tricolor).

siam_1914.desc: Kingdom of Siam before 1917: plain red field with a large white elephant (facing left, standing, with ornate ceremonial cloth) in the center.

serbia_1914.desc: Kingdom of Serbia 1914: three equal horizontal stripes, red on top, blue in the middle, white at the bottom, no emblem.

new_zealand.desc: New Zealand 1914/1939: dark blue ensign; Union Jack in the upper-left canton; four red five-pointed stars with white borders forming the Southern Cross on the fly side.

china_1914.desc: Republic of China 1912-1928 Five-Colored Flag: five equal horizontal stripes, from top red, yellow, blue, white, black.

spain_1914.desc: Kingdom of Spain 1914: horizontal red, yellow, red stripes in 1:2:1 ratio, with the Bourbon royal coat of arms (crowned shield) on the hoist side of the yellow stripe.

south_africa_1928.desc: Union of South Africa 1928-1994: three horizontal stripes orange, white, blue; in the center of the white stripe three small flags: Union Jack, Orange Free State flag, and Transvaal flag.

iraq_kingdom.desc: Kingdom of Iraq 1932-1958: three horizontal stripes black, white, green; a red trapezoid on the hoist side containing two white seven-pointed stars.

mongolia_1939.desc: Mongolian People's Republic 1939: red field; golden-yellow Soyombo symbol on the hoist side.

egypt_kingdom.desc: Kingdom of Egypt 1922-1952: plain green field with a white crescent and three white five-pointed stars inside the crescent.

ussr.desc: Soviet Union: solid red field; golden-yellow hammer and sickle in the upper hoist corner with a gold-outlined red five-pointed star above it.

slovakia_1939.desc: Slovak State 1939-1945: three horizontal stripes white, blue, red; a red shield with a white double cross over blue hills on the hoist side.

yugoslavia_kingdom.desc: Kingdom of Yugoslavia 1918-1941: three equal horizontal stripes blue, white, red; no emblem.

china_roc.desc: Republic of China 1928-1949: red field with a blue canton in the upper hoist corner containing a white 12-rayed sun.

spain_franco.desc: Spain 1938-1945 (Franco): horizontal red, yellow, red stripes (1:2:1) with the Francoist coat of arms (black eagle of St. John holding a shield, with pillars of Hercules) on the yellow stripe.

uar.desc: United Arab Republic 1958-1971: three horizontal stripes red, white, black; two green five-pointed stars on the white stripe.

cuba.desc: Cuba: five horizontal stripes blue, white, blue, white, blue; a red equilateral triangle on the hoist side with a white five-pointed star inside.

vietnam_north.desc: North Vietnam 1955-1976: solid red field with a large yellow five-pointed star in the center.

yugoslavia_federal.desc: Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia: three equal horizontal stripes blue, white, red; a red five-pointed star with a gold border in the center.

czechoslovakia.desc: Czechoslovakia: two horizontal stripes, white on top and red at the bottom; a blue isosceles triangle from the hoist reaching to the center.

china_prc.desc: People's Republic of China: solid red field; large yellow five-pointed star in the upper hoist corner, with four smaller yellow stars in an arc to its right.

rome.desc: Roman Empire (SPQR vexillum): deep crimson-red square-ish banner with golden 'SPQR' lettering in the center and a golden eagle above it.

persia_empire.desc: Achaemenid Persian Empire: golden-yellow field with a blue-and-gold Faravahar (winged disc) in the center.

mongol_empire.desc: Mongol Empire: sky-blue field with a golden-yellow Soyombo emblem on the hoist side.

british_empire.desc: British Empire: red ensign (red field) with the Union Jack in the upper-left canton and a golden globe-and-crown badge on the fly side.

gran_colombia.desc: Gran Colombia 1819: three horizontal stripes yellow (double height), blue, red with a small coat of arms (fasces and cornucopia) in the center of the yellow stripe.

north_union.desc: Fictional Northern Union (Kalmar-style): blue field with a golden Nordic cross offset to the hoist side, with three small golden crowns on the cross.

central_america.desc: Federal Republic of Central America 1823-1841: three horizontal stripes blue, white, blue; in the center a small coat of arms: triangle with five volcanoes, a rainbow, a Phrygian cap, and a sun.

somaliland.desc: Somaliland: three equal horizontal stripes green, white, red; white Arabic Shahada text in the green stripe; a black five-pointed star in the center of the white stripe.

northern_cyprus.desc: Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus: white field with thin red horizontal stripes at the top and bottom edges; a red crescent and a red five-pointed star in the center.

zayyanid.desc: Zayyanid sultanate of Tlemcen, 14th century: plain white banner with a thin green border and a centered green crescent.

aboriginal.desc: Fictional unified banner for Aboriginal Australian peoples: split horizontally black over red, with a large ochre-yellow disc in the center.

adal_ifat.desc: Medieval Horn of Africa sultanate: green banner with a white crescent and a white five-pointed star.

akan.desc: Akan kingdoms (Ghana region): horizontal red, gold, green stripes with a black Adinkra 'Gye Nyame' symbol in the center.

algonquin_iroquois.desc: Haudenosaunee/Algonquin confederacy: purple field with the white Hiawatha wampum belt design (a white tree in the center joined by two white squares left and right).

golden_horde.desc: Golden Horde: deep golden-yellow field with a red or black tamga (stylized trident-like clan mark) in the center.

anatolian_beyliks_w.desc: Western Anatolian Turkish beyliks: red banner with a white crescent and white six-pointed star, in a medieval style.

anatolian_beyliks_e.desc: Eastern Anatolian Turkish beyliks: white banner with a green crescent facing right and a green six-pointed star.

anjou_epirus.desc: Angevin Albania with Epirus: blue field covered with golden fleurs-de-lis, with a red label across the top.

taino.desc: Taíno chiefdoms of the Caribbean: sky-blue banner with a stylized golden sun with a face (Taíno zemi symbol) in the center.

aragon.desc: Crown of Aragon: the Senyera, nine horizontal stripes alternating gold and red (four red, five gold), no other charges.

arab_tribes.desc: Arab tribal emirates: plain green banner with a white sword (horizontal) under white Arabic-style calligraphic band.

albania_skanderbeg.desc: Albanian principalities / League of Lezhë: red field with a black double-headed eagle in the center.

ava_pegu.desc: Medieval Burmese kingdoms (Ava, Pegu, Toungoo): red banner with a golden hintha (mythical goose) in the center.

ayutthaya.desc: Ayutthaya/Sukhothai kingdom of Siam: red banner with a golden garuda or a white chakra wheel in the center.

knights_hospitaller.desc: Knights Hospitaller: red field with a white eight-pointed Maltese cross.

aztec.desc: Aztec Triple Alliance: turquoise banner with a stylized golden Aztec sun or an eagle on a cactus in the center.

bahmani.desc: Bahmani sultanate (Deccan): green banner with a golden crescent and a golden sun-ray emblem.

bengal.desc: Bengal sultanate: green banner with a white crescent and white eight-pointed star.

bornu.desc: Kanem-Bornu empire: red banner with a white lion or a white sword above a black horizontal band.

bosnia.desc: Medieval Kingdom of Bosnia: white field with a blue shield bearing six golden fleurs-de-lis (Kotromanić arms) in the center.

brunei.desc: Brunei sultanate: yellow banner with a diagonal black-and-white stripe pair and a red crescent in the center.

bulgaria.desc: Second Bulgarian Empire: red banner with a golden crowned lion rampant.

bunyoro.desc: Bunyoro-Kitara kingdom: black, white and red vertical stripes with a stylized spear and drum emblem in the center.

burgundy.desc: Burgundy/Flanders: gold field with a black lion rampant (Flanders), or red saltire cross (Burgundian cross) on white.

zimbabwe.desc: Great Zimbabwe / Mutapa: banner of green and yellow stripes with a black Zimbabwe-bird emblem in the center.

jalayirid.desc: Jalayirid/Kara Koyunlu: black banner with a white crescent and star, or two lions facing a sun.

algiers.desc: Regency of Algiers (Barbarossa): red banner with a white crescent and a white star, and a white double-pointed sword.

dai_viet.desc: Dai Viet: red banner with a golden dragon in the center.

denmark_norway.desc: Denmark-Norway: red field with a white Nordic cross (Dannebrog), and a golden crowned lion on the Norwegian side.

delhi.desc: Delhi sultanate: green banner with a white crescent and white sun emblem.

demak.desc: Demak sultanate (Java): white banner with a green crescent and a red sun in the center.

wallachia_moldavia.desc: Wallachia and Moldavia: split vertically, left red with a golden eagle holding a cross (Wallachia), right red with an aurochs head and a star between its horns (Moldavia).

ethiopia.desc: Ethiopian empire of the Solomonic dynasty: horizontal green, yellow, red with a golden Lion of Judah holding a cross in the center.

philippines.desc: Philippine barangay/sultanates: red banner with a white crescent and a golden sun with eight rays.

funj.desc: Funj sultanate / Nubian kingdoms: green and yellow horizontal stripes with a white lion in the center.

goryeo_joseon.desc: Goryeo/Joseon Korea: white banner with a red-and-blue taegeuk swirl in the center, without trigrams.

south_india.desc: South Indian dynasties: saffron-yellow banner with a red boar facing right and a crescent and sun above it (Vijayanagara).

georgia.desc: Kingdom of Georgia: white banner with a large red St George's cross and four smaller red crosses in the quadrants (Bolnisi).

habsburg.desc: House of Habsburg: banner with a red lion rampant on gold, or a black double-headed eagle on gold, crowned.

hafsid.desc: Hafsid dynasty of Tunis: white banner with a black Arabic band and a red crescent.

hausa_benin.desc: Hausa city-states and Benin kingdom: red banner with a golden leopard or a brass-colored ceremonial sword in the center.

hormuz.desc: Kingdom of Hormuz: white banner with a red-striped border and a blue wave band across the bottom.

kabul_kandahar.desc: Kabul/Kandahar/Herat principalities: black banner with a white mosque and a white crescent.

kamakura.desc: Kamakura Shogunate: white banner with a black mon of three-leaf hollyhock, in the style of Japanese nobori.

karamanids.desc: Karamanids / Armenian Cilicia: red banner with a white crescent; Cilicia part: blue banner with a golden lion.

kastilya.desc: Kingdom of Castile: red banner with a golden castle with three towers and blue windows (Castile) next to a purple lion (León) in the second quarter.

kazakh_steppe.desc: Kazakh/Crimean steppe khanates: sky-blue banner with a golden steppe eagle in the center (Crimea: yellow banner with a gold tamga).

khmer.desc: Khmer empire: red banner with the five towers of Angkor Wat in white in the center.

kilwa.desc: Kilwa/Swahili coast: green banner with a white crescent and a white dhow (sailing ship).

kongo.desc: Kingdom of Kongo: white banner with a blue shield showing an arm holding a sword (Kongo arms), or a red field with a golden crown.

north_american.desc: North American native confederacies: fictional banner, earth-red field with a white central circle containing a black eagle feather symbol.

northern_yuan.desc: Northern Yuan / Mongol khanates: light blue banner with a yellow Mongol nine-yak-tail standard (tug) emblem, or golden soyombo.

cyprus_lusignan.desc: Lusignan Kingdom of Cyprus: white field with a golden Jerusalem cross, plus lion of Lusignan (red and silver stripes with blue lion).

lan_xang.desc: Lan Xang kingdom: red banner with a white three-headed elephant under a white parasol.

livonia.desc: Livonian/Teutonic Order: white field with a black cross pattée.

madagascar.desc: Madagascar kingdoms: red and white vertical halves with a gold spear emblem in the center.

majapahit.desc: Majapahit empire: the Gula Kelapa banner, nine horizontal stripes alternating red and white.

malacca.desc: Malacca/Malay sultanates: yellow banner with a red crescent and a red keris dagger.

maldives.desc: Maldive sultanate: red banner with a green rectangle in the center containing a white crescent.

mali.desc: Mali/Songhay empire: green, yellow, red horizontal stripes with a black lion on the yellow stripe; Songhay: add a white crescent.

maya.desc: Maya city-states: jade-green banner with a golden glyph-style sun god face in the center.

melanesia.desc: Melanesia/Pacific peoples: fictional banner, ocean-blue field with a white canoe and a red star in the center.

marinid.desc: Marinid/Wattasid/Saadi dynasties of Morocco: plain red banner (Wattasid) with a green seal of Solomon five-pointed star in the center.

moghulistan.desc: Central Asian khanates (Chagatai, Moghulistan, Uzbek): sky-blue banner with a white crescent and a gold tamga.

muisca.desc: Muisca and Carib chiefdoms: golden-yellow banner with a green El Dorado raft figure in the center.

muromachi.desc: Muromachi/Sengoku Japan: white banner with a red sun disc, with golden chrysanthemum seal above it.

muzaffarid.desc: Muzaffarids / Sarbadars / Ilkhanate governors of Persia: green banner with a gold lion-and-sun (shir-o-khorshid) emblem.

naples_anjou.desc: Kingdom of Naples (Anjou/Aragon): blue field with golden fleurs-de-lis and a red label (Anjou), or red-and-gold stripes (Aragon).

novgorod.desc: Novgorod Republic: red banner with a white saint (Saint George) on a white horse slaying a dragon.

portugal.desc: Kingdom of Portugal, medieval: white field with a blue cross-shaped escutcheon and seven golden castles on red border (Portuguese royal arms).

rasulid.desc: Rasulid Yemen: red banner with a white crescent and white sword, in a medieval style.

sindh_multan.desc: Sindh/Multan principalities: green banner with a white crescent and a white sword.

serbia.desc: Medieval Serbia: red field with a white Serbian cross carrying four firesteels (Ocila) in the quarters, or a white double-headed eagle.

taiwan.desc: Taiwan indigenous peoples: fictional banner, teal green field with a white central stylized mountain and sun.

tibet.desc: Tibet/Himalaya: the Snow Lion flag, white snow lion on a banner with sun, blue and red rays.

tupi.desc: Tupi-Guarani peoples: fictional banner, green field with a red feather headdress in the center.

oman.desc: Oman (Nabhani/Ibadi imamate): plain red banner with a white khanjar dagger and crossed swords.

ilkhanate.desc: Ilkhanate: light blue banner with a gold lion-and-sun and white crescent.

inca.desc: Inca empire: the seven-colored wiphala checkered flag (rainbow squares) in the center of a white banner.

ireland.desc: Irish lordships: blue field with a golden harp with silver strings.

sweden.desc: Kingdom of Sweden, medieval: blue banner with three golden crowns (two over one).

switzerland.desc: Old Swiss Confederacy: red banner with a white cross (Schwyz style).
